name: Delta Flower Scarab
desc: Delta Flower Scarab (Trigonopeltastes delta): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Trigonopeltastes delta, the delta flower scarab or D beetle, is a diurnal species of scarab beetle native to the southeastern United States, though their range extends as far north as New Jersey.
